title: Omni-Diffusion-Distill: Few-Step Distillation of Unified Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
abstract: Unified multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a single architecture for both image generation and multimodal understanding, but their iterative decoding requires tens to hundreds of forward passes. Existing few-step distillation methods largely focus on either image generation or text generation, making it unclear how to compress a fully discrete multimodal dLLM into a single efficient student while preserving both generation and understanding. We introduce Omni-Diffusion-Distill, a unified two-stage distillation framework that retains strong generation and understanding capabilities while substantially reducing the inference cost of a unified multimodal dLLM. Omni-Diffusion-Distill aligns the distillation of both generation and understanding, for both images and text, in the discrete token space. In the first stage, the student is trained to skip decoding steps by replaying cached teacher trajectories, and in the second stage the student is refined on intermediate states along its own rollouts. We further remedy two sources of degradation in unified distillation with a pairwise collision penalty that reduces repetition under parallel text decoding, and entropy-matched guidance that prevents entropy collapse caused by fitting the sharpened teacher distribution in image generation. Omni-Diffusion-Distill achieves state-of-the-art trade-offs between decoding efficiency and generation and understanding performance for multimodal dLLMs, reducing image generation from 128 to 8 decoding steps and multimodal understanding from 512 to 64, giving 18.2x and 21.2x wall-clock speedups. Under these budgets, it scores 0.828 on GenEval and 83.0 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation, while reaching GPT judge scores of 20.0 on MM-Vet and 57.2 on COCO captioning (twice the teacher's 28.4 at the same steps) for multimodal understanding.

summary.title_zh: 全模态扩散蒸馏：统一多模态扩散大语言模型的少步蒸馏
summary.core_contribution: 提出了一种统一的少步蒸馏框架Omni-Diffusion-Distill，能够在保持多模态大语言模型（dLLM）的图像生成与多模态理解能力的同时，大幅减少推理步骤，实现18倍以上的实际加速。
summary.method: 该方法采用两阶段蒸馏策略：第一阶段让学生模型通过重放缓存的教师轨迹来跳过解码步骤；第二阶段利用学生自身生成的中间状态进行精炼。此外，引入成对碰撞惩罚以减少并行文本解码中的重复问题，并使用熵匹配引导防止图像生成中因拟合尖锐教师分布导致的熵崩溃。
summary.findings: 在图像生成任务中，将解码步骤从128步减少至8步，多模态理解从512步减少至64步，分别获得18.2倍和21.2倍的实际加速。在GenEval上得分为0.828，DPG-Bench上为83.0；多模态理解方面，MM-Vet的GPT评分为20.0，COCO字幕生成得分为57.2（相同步数下为教师模型28.4的两倍）。

title: DOGS: Design-Space Sampling for Prompt-Driven Logo Generation
abstract: Prompt optimization for text-to-image (T2I) generation has been pursued almost entirely as text rewriting, in which a short user brief is expanded into a longer, model-preferred token sequence. We argue that such a language-space formulation is ill-suited to structured visual design tasks such as logo creation, where a one-line brief leaves most design decisions unspecified. These decisions depend on relational priors that a linear sequence cannot encode, and they leave an uncontrolled channel through which protected marks may be reproduced. We therefore recast logo prompting as sampling within a structured design space, and instantiate this idea as DOGS (Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler). From a large corpus of real-world logos, we mine a typed, graph-structured design grammar whose edges record empirical co-occurrence. A GFlowNet sampler then generates design graphs with probability proportional to a terminal reward that combines recognizability, aesthetics, and corpus-relative originality. Every slot draws only from a closed design-level vocabulary, and any infringement-inducing or harmful token is removed during parsing. The originality reward further penalizes proximity to existing logos, thereby incorporating infringement avoidance into the method by construction. On two open-source renderers and against nine baselines, DOGS produces logos that are more recognizable and aesthetic, substantially more diverse, and far less prone to trademark infringement.

summary.title_zh: DOGS：面向提示驱动标志生成的设计空间采样
summary.core_contribution: 本文提出将标志生成中的提示优化问题从文本改写重新定义为结构化设计空间中的采样，并设计了DOGS框架，通过图结构设计语法和原创性感知的GFlowNet采样器，在提升标志可识别性、美观性和多样性的同时，有效避免商标侵权。
summary.method: 首先，从真实标志语料库中挖掘出带类型的图结构设计语法，其边记录了经验共现关系。然后，利用GFlowNet采样器生成设计图，其概率与一个结合可识别性、美学和语料相对原创性的终端奖励成正比。每个设计槽仅从封闭的设计级词汇中抽取，并在解析过程中移除任何可能侵权的或有害的标记。原创性奖励进一步惩罚与现有标志的接近度，从而将侵权避免内置于方法中。
summary.findings: 在两个开源渲染器上，与九个基线方法相比，DOGS生成的标志在可识别性和美观性上更优，多样性显著更高，并且商标侵权风险大幅降低。

title: QuadTok: Quadtree Visual Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
abstract: We introduce QuadTok, a novel framework for visual tokenization and autoregressive image generation. Compared to traditional approaches using 2D grids or 1D token sequences, we propose a hierarchical quadtree structure, bridging the gap between 2D spatial binding and 1D sequence-level flexibility. The QuadTok tokenizer dynamically allocates representational capacity to visually intricate areas while leaving homogeneous regions at a coarse resolution. Compared with a fixed 256-token grid, our ImageNet-trained tokenizer saves approximately 10% of tokens on ImageNet and 9% when transferred zero-shot to the COCO dataset, while maintaining comparable reconstruction fidelity. Furthermore, the natural causality introduced by the tree structure seamlessly enables autoregressive image generation. Conditioned on a quadtree topology supplied before generation, our 947M GPT-style generative model achieves a 2.08 gFID on the ImageNet $256 \times 256$ benchmark. Additionally, leveraging the strong spatial correlation preserved by the quadtree structure, the QuadTok generator enables zero-shot spatially controlled image generation capabilities. Code: https://github.com/myc634/QuadTok.

summary.title_zh: QuadTok：用于自回归图像生成的四叉树视觉分词器
summary.core_contribution: 提出了一种基于四叉树层次结构的视觉分词框架QuadTok，在保持重建质量的同时动态节省约10%的token，并利用树结构的自然因果性实现了高质量的自回归图像生成和零样本空间可控生成。
summary.method: QuadTok采用四叉树结构对图像进行层次化分词：首先将图像划分为粗粒度网格，然后根据局部视觉复杂度递归细分区域，为复杂区域分配更多token，而均匀区域保持粗分辨率。该分词器通过可学习的编码器-解码器架构将每个四叉树节点映射为离散token，并利用树结构的自然因果顺序（从根到叶）组织token序列。生成阶段，一个GPT风格的自回归模型以预定的四叉树拓扑为条件，逐节点预测图像token。
summary.findings: 在ImageNet 256×256基准上，QuadTok分词器相比固定256-token网格节省约10%的token（零样本迁移到COCO节省9%），且重建保真度相当；其947M参数的生成模型在ImageNet上达到2.08 gFID；此外，四叉树结构保留的空间相关性使模型具备零样本空间可控生成能力。

title: From Pixel to Coding: Evaluating the Figure Reproduction Capabilities of MLLMs
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in both visual understanding and code generation. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate these two modalities in isolation, lacking a dedicated assessment of their unification, i.e., how a model can perceive complex visual structures and synthesize them into precise, executable code. Moreover, current visual code generation benchmarks often rely on simplified layouts within single programming environments, falling short of evaluating true unified multimodal reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose FigCodeBench, a comprehensive framework for rigorously evaluating MLLMs on figure reproduction, integrating multimodal comprehension and generation. We first design a systematic dataset construction pipeline, resulting in a total of 6,194 instances that cover 7 functional categories and 4 types of programming languages. We further categorize figure reproduction into three tiers with visual and code complexity modeling, specifically targeting complex structural reasoning, varying aspect ratios, and dense geometric constraints. We introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol, encompassing visual fidelity and syntactic isomorphism, that aligns highly with the Mean Machine Opinion Score (MMOS) and human preferences. Based on our framework, we conducted extensive experiments on 24 widely used proprietary and open-source MLLMs (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.4, and Kimi-K2.5), where we observed a universal, non-linear performance cliff across different programming languages and difficulty scenarios for all models, and gained several insights, such as the significant metric decline in rigid declarative languages.

summary.title_zh: 从像素到编码：评估多模态大语言模型的图形复现能力
summary.core_contribution: 提出了FigCodeBench，一个专门评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图形复现任务中统一视觉理解与代码生成能力的综合框架，填补了现有基准测试中缺乏对这两种模态融合评估的空白。
summary.method: 首先设计了一个系统化的数据集构建流程，生成了包含6,194个实例的数据集，覆盖7个功能类别和4种编程语言。然后将图形复现任务按视觉与代码复杂度分为三个层级，重点考察复杂结构推理、不同宽高比和密集几何约束。最后引入了一个多维评估协议，包括视觉保真度和语法同构性，并与平均机器意见分数（MMOS）及人类偏好高度对齐。
summary.findings: 在24个广泛使用的专有和开源MLLMs（如Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.4和Kimi-K2.5）上进行了大量实验，观察到所有模型在不同编程语言和难度场景下均存在普遍的非线性性能悬崖，并发现刚性声明式语言中指标显著下降等关键洞察。

title: Diffusion Meta-Prompting and Steering for Generalizable Foundation Model Adaptation
abstract: Prompt learning is a popular method for adapting foundation models, but learned prompts are typically task-specific and fail to generalize to new classes, domains, or compositions of tasks. In this paper, we introduce a Diffusion Meta-Prompt (DMP) model , a framework that models the distribution of learned prompts using diffusion models. Given a repository of previously learned prompts, DMP is trained and sampled without access to the original task examples or task losses, and synthesizes new prompts conditioned on natural language task descriptions. To improve the sampling stability, we introduce a test-time steering strategy for DMP, which uses the best training-selected prompt in the repository as a latent anchor during diffusion sampling, without retraining the DMP or accessing test classes. DMP improves generalization across classification, retrieval and text-to-image generation tasks, supports concept composition and negative prompting without explicit training. It reduces storage and inference costs by over 90% compared to prompt retrieval methods. For composite classification, DMP achieves upto 2.0% average gain over prior meta-learning methods across 55 pairs of datasets with gains as high as 8.5% on specific pairs such as Eurosat and Flowers. DMP also enhances cross-task generalization with ~2-9% improvement for hierarchical classification task. We further provide a theoretical guarantee bounding the expected task loss of prompts sampled from a DMP. Code is available: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp

summary.title_zh: 扩散元提示与引导：面向通用基础模型适配的方法
summary.core_contribution: 提出一种基于扩散模型的元提示框架（DMP），能够从已学习的提示库中生成新提示，无需原始任务数据或损失函数，显著提升基础模型在分类、检索和文本到图像生成等任务上的泛化能力。
summary.method: DMP首先利用扩散模型对先前学习到的提示分布进行建模，并在训练和采样过程中不依赖原始任务样本或任务损失。采样时，通过一种测试时引导策略，将训练集中最优提示作为潜在锚点，以提升采样稳定性。该方法支持基于自然语言任务描述的条件生成，并能够实现概念组合与负提示。
summary.findings: DMP在复合分类任务中，相比先前的元学习方法，在55个数据集对上平均提升2.0%，特定对（如Eurosat与Flowers）提升高达8.5%；在层次分类任务中，跨任务泛化提升约2-9%。同时，与提示检索方法相比，存储和推理成本降低超过90%。
